entries.sense_note: time for one person to play/act

def.micro: your time to play or do it
def.short: the time when one person in a group can play or do something, one after another
def.long: The time when one person in a group can play or do something, when people do it one after another. People say "It's your turn" or "take turns".

examples.en: Roll the dice, Zeynep. It's your turn.
examples.tr: Zarı at Zeynep. Sıra sende.

examples.en: The kids took turns on the swing in the park.
examples.tr: Çocuklar parkta salıncağa sırayla bindi.

examples.en: It's Esra's turn to choose the film tonight.
examples.tr: Bu akşam filmi seçme sırası Esra'da.

tr.note: Türkçe 'sıra' iki şeydir: oyunda ya da bir işte birinin zamanı 'turn', insanların arka arkaya dizildiği sıra ise 'queue' (ABD'de 'line') olur.

quiz.cloze: You went first last time, so it's my ______ to start.

def.micro: what you must or can't do
def.short: something that tells you what you can or cannot do in a game, a school or a home
def.long: Something that tells people what they are allowed or not allowed to do, for example in a game, a school or a home. You can follow it or break it.

grammar.pattern: the rules of sth; follow/break a rule

examples.en: Can you explain the rules of this game?
examples.tr: Bu oyunun kurallarını açıklayabilir misin?

examples.en: In our house, the rule is simple: no phones at dinner.
examples.tr: Bizim evde kural basit: akşam yemeğinde telefon yok.

examples.en: Murat broke the rules, so the other players didn't want to play with him again.
examples.tr: Murat kuralları çiğnedi, bu yüzden diğer oyuncular onunla bir daha oynamak istemedi.

tr.note: 'Kurala uymak' İngilizcede 'follow the rules', 'kuralı çiğnemek' ise 'break the rules' olur.

quiz.cloze: You can't move that piece there. It's against the ______!

def.micro: a black and white board game
def.short: a game for two on a black and white board, with kings, queens and other pieces
def.long: A game for two players on a board of black and white squares. Each player moves pieces and tries to trap the other player's king.

examples.en: My grandfather taught me how to play chess.
examples.tr: Dedem bana satranç oynamayı öğretti.

examples.en: Hana and Lucas play chess online every evening.
examples.tr: Hana ile Lucas her akşam internette satranç oynuyor.

examples.en: Elif joined the chess club at school, and now she often beats her dad.
examples.tr: Elif okuldaki satranç kulübüne katıldı ve artık babasını sık sık yeniyor.

tr.note: Oyun adlarının önüne 'the' gelmez: 'play chess'. Taşlara 'pieces', şaha 'king', vezire 'queen' denir. 'Şah mat' ise 'checkmate' olur.

quiz.cloze: Do you want to play ______? You can have the white pieces, and I'll be black.

def.short: a game you play on a screen, like on a computer, a phone or a TV
def.long: A game that you play on a screen, like a computer, a phone or a TV. You control the people or things in it with buttons, a keyboard or by touching the screen.

examples.en: My son plays video games after his homework.
examples.tr: Oğlum ödevinden sonra video oyunu oynuyor.

examples.en: Diego spent all of Saturday playing a new video game.
examples.tr: Diego bütün cumartesiyi yeni bir video oyunu oynayarak geçirdi.

examples.en: Some video games are more fun when you play them with friends online.
examples.tr: Bazı video oyunları internette arkadaşlarla oynayınca daha eğlenceli oluyor.

tr.note: Bilgisayarda oynanana 'computer game' de denir. Günlük dilde çoğu zaman kısaca 'game' yeterlidir: 'What games do you play?'

quiz.cloze: Kerem uses a controller to play ______ on the big TV.

def.micro: have a game with a deck
def.short: have a game with a set of 52 small paper pieces with numbers and pictures
def.long: To have a game using a set of 52 small, thin pieces of paper with numbers and pictures on them. People often do this with family or friends.

examples.en: We often play cards at my aunt's house.
examples.tr: Teyzemin evinde sık sık kâğıt oynarız.

examples.en: On the long train journey, Yuki and Omar played cards to pass the time.
examples.tr: Uzun tren yolculuğunda Yuki ile Omar vakit geçirmek için kâğıt oynadı.

examples.en: Do you know how to play cards? We need a fourth player.
examples.tr: Kâğıt oynamayı biliyor musun? Dördüncü bir oyuncuya ihtiyacımız var.

tr.note: Bütün desteye 'a deck of cards' (İngiltere'de 'a pack of cards') denir. Kâğıtları karmak 'shuffle', dağıtmak ise 'deal' olur.

quiz.cloze: After dinner, Grandpa took out a deck and said, "Let's ______!"

def.short: a game for two players who throw dice and move round pieces around a board
def.long: A game for two players. They throw dice and move round pieces around a board, and the first player to take all their pieces off the board wins.

examples.en: My dad plays backgammon with his friends at the café.
examples.tr: Babam kahvede arkadaşlarıyla tavla oynar.

examples.en: Leyla threw a double six and won at backgammon.
examples.tr: Leyla düşeş attı ve tavlada kazandı.

examples.en: In summer, people play backgammon outside, and you can hear the dice everywhere.
examples.tr: Yazın insanlar dışarıda tavla oynar ve her yerden zar sesi duyulur.

tr.note: Zara 'dice' denir; tek zar resmî dilde 'a die', günlük dilde 'a dice' olur. Pullar 'pieces' ya da 'checkers', 'düşeş' ise 'double six' olur.

quiz.cloze: Hakan threw the dice and moved two pieces. He loves playing ______.

def.short: see many episodes of a TV show one after another, often in one day
def.long: To see many episodes of a TV series one after another, often in one day or one weekend. It is an informal word.

examples.en: I binge-watched six episodes last night.
examples.tr: Dün gece art arda altı bölüm izledim.

examples.en: Sara stayed home on Sunday and binge-watched a crime show.
examples.tr: Sara pazar günü evde kaldı ve bir polisiye diziyi art arda izledi.

examples.en: Let's not binge-watch tonight; we both have to get up early tomorrow.
examples.tr: Bu akşam art arda dizi izlemeyelim; ikimiz de yarın erken kalkmak zorundayız.

tr.note: Gündelik bir sözcüktür. Geçmiş zamanı 'binge-watched' olur. Türkçedeki 'dizi maratonu yapmak' ifadesine yakındır.

quiz.cloze: It rained all weekend, so we stayed on the sofa and ______ eight episodes.

def.micro: small box to control the TV
def.short: a small device with buttons that you use to control a TV from your seat
def.long: A small device with buttons that you hold in your hand. You use it to turn on a TV, change channels or make the sound louder.

examples.en: Can you pass me the remote, please?
examples.tr: Kumandayı uzatır mısın lütfen?

examples.en: Nina lost the remote again; it was under a sofa cushion.
examples.tr: Nina kumandayı yine kaybetti; bir koltuk minderinin altındaymış.

examples.en: When there's a match on, my kids always argue about who gets the remote.
examples.tr: Maç olduğunda çocuklarım kumandanın kimde olacağı konusunda hep tartışır.

tr.note: Tam adı 'remote control'. Klima kumandası için de kullanılır. Sıfat olarak 'remote' 'uzak, ıssız' demektir: 'a remote village'.

quiz.cloze: I want to change the channel, but I can't find the ______.

def.micro: a set of episodes of a show
def.short: a group of episodes of a TV series that come out one after another
def.long: A group of episodes of a TV series that come out one after another, usually once a year. A popular series can go on for many years.

examples.en: The second season of the show starts in May.
examples.tr: Dizinin ikinci sezonu mayısta başlıyor.

examples.en: Deniz loved the first season, but the second one was boring.
examples.tr: Deniz ilk sezonu çok sevdi ama ikincisi sıkıcıydı.

examples.en: They are filming season three now, so we have to wait until next year.
examples.tr: Şu an üçüncü sezonu çekiyorlar, bu yüzden seneye kadar beklememiz gerekiyor.

tr.note: Aynı kelime 'mevsim' demektir. İngiltere'de dizi sezonuna 'series' de denir: 'series two'. Ama 'series' asıl olarak dizinin kendisidir.

quiz.cloze: The show is back! Its new ______ has ten episodes.

def.micro: the last part of a story
def.short: the last part of a film, book or story
def.long: The last part of a film, book or story, where you learn what happens to the people in it. People often talk about a happy or a sad one.

examples.en: The film had a happy ending.
examples.tr: Filmin sonu mutluydu.

examples.en: Don't tell me the ending! I haven't finished the book yet.
examples.tr: Sonunu söyleme! Kitabı daha bitirmedim.

examples.en: Chloe cried at the ending of the last episode.
examples.tr: Chloe son bölümün finalini izlerken ağladı.

tr.note: Bir filmin ya da kitabın nasıl bittiğini anlatırken 'ending' kullanılır. Filmin sonunu önceden anlatan bilgiye 'spoiler' denir.

mistakes.wrong: The film has a happy end.
mistakes.right: The film has a happy ending.
mistakes.why: Türkçede filmler için 'happy end' denir; İngilizcede doğrusu 'happy ending' olur. 'End' tek başına bir şeyin bittiği yer ya da an demektir.

quiz.cloze: Most fairy tales have a happy ______: everyone lives happily ever after.
